mani.title: How we work
mani.origin: 15+ years in the industry taught us one thing: great ideas only matter when they work. We know how to build and package a business so it doesn’t just look good, it delivers real value. North Whale Studio is where that experience lives.
mani.p1: First we get to know your business. *Design grows out of meaning,* not out of a template.
mani.p2: One team runs the project *from idea to launch:* meaning, design, animation, website.
mani.p3: A website is the first thing a client sees. That’s why *it works from the first second* on any screen.
mani.whyBody: A whale works deep down for a long time, then surfaces so you can see it a mile away. So do we: we dig for meaning quietly and show the result loudly.
